name: select-field
summary: Renders an accessible native select with checked choices, optional help, errors, and disabled state.

agent.useWhen: An app-owned form needs a labelled selection from a fixed, validated set of options.
agent.avoidWhen: Options are dynamic or require rich content, searchable widgets, runtime scripts, or component-owned submission and validation behavior.

invariants: Every control has a visible label associated by for/id; hint and error descriptions use deterministic described-by wiring.
Choices contain 1..=100 unique nonblank values; selected must match an enabled choice.
All values and labels are escaped plain text; choice values are not HTML or raw attributes.
required and disabled are native boolean attributes; the app owns its form, command, route, submission, and domain validation.
No raw markup, arbitrary attributes, scripts, routes, or commands are emitted.
The fragment contains exactly one [[attributes]], [[label]], [[control]], and [[description]] slot; expansion is exact and single-pass.

attributes.name: id
rules: Use a safe select ID; reserve its derived -hint and -error IDs.

attributes.name: name
rules: Use a safe nonreserved form field name.

attributes.name: label
rules: Must be nonblank plain text.

attributes.name: selected
rules: A literal or one whole checked string field.

attributes.name: placeholder
rules: Plain text literal or whole checked string field.

attributes.name: hint
rules: Plain text literal or whole checked string field.

attributes.name: error
rules: Plain text literal or whole checked string field.

attributes.name: required
rules: Boolean literal true or false.

attributes.name: disabled
rules: Boolean literal true or false.

attributes.name: choices
rules: Alternative to child options: JSON array of typed choice objects; cannot be combined with child options.
Canonical paired template form uses cui-option children. The existing JSON choices property is the alternative static-data form; do not combine the two.
The component can also be used self-closing with choices JSON where the host declaration syntax permits it.
Options are plain text only; no rich option markup.

attributes.name: value
rules: A literal or one whole checked string field.

attributes.name: label
rules: A literal or one whole checked string field.

attributes.name: disabled
rules: Boolean literal true or false.
Option values must be unique and nonblank; selected must match an enabled option.
The helper has no body or markup content.
Exactly one source of options is used: child options or the choices JSON property.
Whole-field bindings are checked by Native template admission; values and labels are emitted as escaped text.
The app owns form submission, routes, commands, and domain validation.

examples.name: customer-status
examples.summary: A select whose options come from app-owned choices and whose selected value is bound to the customer.
examples.template:
<cui-select-field id="customer-status" name="status" label="Status" selected="{{ customer.status }}">
  {% for choice in status_choices %}
  <cui-option value="{{ choice.value }}" label="{{ choice.label }}" />
  {% endfor %}
</cui-select-field>
requirements: App provides customer.status and status_choices iterable with string value and label fields.
The selected value must match an enabled option; the app owns its form and submission behavior.
